note: dev#87/#89/#91: bundled fallback list for suppressing false-positive Palworld version-mismatch warnings. 'known_versions' is the fast fingerprint path (Steam buildid + Pal-Windows.pak size, no pak content read, checked at every GUI startup). 'known_vanilla_manifest_sha256' is the dev#91 self-judgment path: the combined_hash from extract_vanilla.py's vanilla_manifest.json (sha256 over the small extracted output set, not the 37.7GB pak) — a future unknown Palworld build is treated as compatible if its extracted materials hash-match one of these, even though its build id/pak size do not appear in known_versions. dl.osakishokai.com/versions.json (dev#89) may extend both arrays via an optional top-level 'palworld_known_good' object with the same two keys; on fetch failure or offline, the client falls back to this bundled file only.
